followup_explanation:
ROUTE: Willet-235B
REASON: The query is a clear, bounded retrieval task (gathering 10 references on a defined topic), which falls squarely into Willet's self-reported top-rated task family of well-specified retrieval requests. Since the two models are effectively tied on Extraction & Retrieval capability (79.2 vs 81.6 — close to the variance threshold and not a meaningful gap for delivery quality), I let the task-preference signal break the tie and sent it to the model that prefers this kind of work.
